owned_index_paragraphs.paragraph: **Continuing concern through transformation of practice, 6 October 2026:** the [constructive argument](_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/PRACTICE-TRANSFORMATION-ARGUMENT.md) explains how a method's own formative effects can defeat repetition on its original grounds, while its earlier success remains true. A fresh bounded reading of an inherited Wang teaching episode supports the reconstruction and retains nearby resistance to challenge. Changing a method or local success judgment under a stable aspiration is a substantive result; it does not derive the aspiration's authority. The [canonical account](theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/unified-2026-10-05/UNIFIED-ETHICAL-GROUNDING.md#continuing-concern-can-require-transforming-its-method) credits retained consequence information and preserves the formal protocol obstruction. The next discrimination is participant capacities restored versus programme compliance restored, with actual effects and the locus of revision identified. No new controller, experiment or formal theorem is claimed.

owned_index_paragraphs.paragraph: **Practice transforms its own conditions of adequacy, 6 October 2026:** the [positive ethical candidate](unified-2026-10-05/UNIFIED-ETHICAL-GROUNDING.md#continuing-concern-can-require-transforming-its-method) now explains how what a practice forms in participants can require changing that practice. Concern can continue while a method changes or ends. The [Wang comparison and Ren genealogy](../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/PRACTICE-TRANSFORMATION-GENEALOGY.md) retain ultimate normative commitments and historical limits; the [review](../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/PRACTICE-TRANSFORMATION-REVIEW.md) distinguishes participant continuation from programme compliance. Existing formal retention and access results remain separate, credited histories. This advances consequential practice revision within the nondual account without claiming universal ethical necessity or a new implementation.

**Constructive practice transformation, 6 October 2026:** [argument](PRACTICE-TRANSFORMATION-ARGUMENT.md), [genealogy and bounded primary reading](PRACTICE-TRANSFORMATION-GENEALOGY.md), and [independent review](PRACTICE-TRANSFORMATION-REVIEW.md) explain a practice forming the conditions that change its own adequacy. Method and local criterion revision remain substantive under a stable aspiration; the latter's ultimate authority is not thereby derived. The historical report preserves counterpressure on contestability. Existing retained-depletion and protocol-access results constrain the comparison without becoming one fictitious history. The [canonical integration](../../../../theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/unified-2026-10-05/UNIFIED-ETHICAL-GROUNDING.md#continuing-concern-can-require-transforming-its-method) sets the next discrimination: participant capacities restored versus programme compliance restored. No new experiment, controller or theorem was added.

owned_index_paragraphs.paragraph: **Ethical continuation: practice transforms its own adequacy, 6 October 2026.** The [constructive account](UNIFIED-ETHICAL-GROUNDING.md#continuing-concern-can-require-transforming-its-method) follows **formation of participant dispositions and possibilities → changed appropriateness of repeating the method → transformation of practice while retaining affected histories**. An inherited Wang episode supplies a bounded positive reconstruction; the stable aspiration and teacher's authority remain substantive commitments. The retained-formation proof and fixed-protocol obstruction retain their own scopes. The next comparison separates restoration of independently identified participant capacities from restoration of compliance alone, with an actual locus and means of revision. Misidentified formative effects, unchanged relevance or disguised coercion would revise the proposed application. No new physical law, empirical result or universal ethical necessity is claimed; this advances the stronger foundation's practice-revision connection under the nondual method.
